worker_target_description: Final report H* (original Hypothesis 1): OLS association of single and childless family structure with work absorption, controlling for biological sex, age, and job level.
worker_notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text identifies itself as Final Report by Janaki Gooty and Andrew McBride, gives Source URL https://osf.io/jx64p/download (matching supplied replication URL), explicitly describes replication of Dumas & Perry-Smith (2018) Hypothesis 1, and ends with the original article title, journal, year, and DOI matching the neutral reference. This is a primary completed replication report, with results and regression table, rather than a preregistration or secondary article. The two report authors overlap the longer supplied replication reference; the full seven-author list, 2025 reference date, and sv4e8 project identifier are not independently printed in the text. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. The requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed in this report. Retained the focal printed b coefficient without conversion or assumption about standardisation. The adjusted R2 and overall F refer to the whole model, not the focal family-structure coefficient; they were not substituted. Target identified by claim summary, H* marker, named predictor, outcome, and model, not row order or numerical matching.
